theme: The trip begins: a Florida checkout, then wheels up for Croatia.
greeting: The daylight is mostly yours, Dan, until 5:55 tonight when you fly to Frankfurt and the Croatia trip finally starts. Use the open hours to close the few things that go dark the moment you're aboard.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags for two 55L duffels. Pull the booking up on the operating carrier's site, confirm the allowance there, and buy it now before it becomes a European counter fee. P1, overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat night and the transfer
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat room and the noon Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer have to be booked before you board; charter connectivity won't manage it once you're at sea. P1, overdue.

needsAttention.title: Reach the Nautilus instructor
needsAttention.detail: Confirm Saturday's boarding time and location and the return transfer to Dubrovnik while you still have reliable signal, not from the boat. P2, due Sept 5.

needsAttention.title: Call Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 18 to Nov 1 rotation booking fires while you're on the water. Decide before you're unreachable so it doesn't book on autopilot. P2, overdue Sept 5.

schedule.title: Check out of the St. Pete house
schedule.detail: The Sept 3-8 stay ends; clean handoff before the airport

schedule.title: Rental car back to TPA
schedule.detail: Return on the way in; larder bin drops at Mom's en route

schedule.title: Flight to Frankfurt
schedule.detail: UA9661 TPA to FRA; Dubrovnik connection tomorrow 9:15 AM

flagged.title: Shareholder Forum on voting vs. exchange of views
flagged.detail: A governance thread on the proxy-contest / imitation-meeting debate landed this morning. No reply needed; worth reading for the board search when you have a plane's worth of time.

inbox.noise: Everything else is sale season: Labor Day extensions, fall catalogs, and travel and language-app deals.
inbox.clear: Check-in is done and boarding passes for both flights are already issued for you and Mike.

resolved.title: Checked in for both flights
resolved.detail: Boarding passes for Tampa to Frankfurt today and Frankfurt to Dubrovnik tomorrow are issued for you and Mike; one less thing for the counter.

recipe.title: Butternut squash & candied bacon on fresh pasta
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first winter squash to market, sweet enough to carry a smoky-savory pasta.

tasks.title: Drop the larder bin at Mom's en route to TPA
Grab EU adapters and a US power strip
Book the Sept 20-22 St. Pete landing nights

acts.line: House checks out at 10 and the rental's due back at TPA by noon, with the larder bin dropping at Mom's on the way.
The open stretch is really a countdown: the bookings that need dry land close when the cabin door does.
Wheels up for Frankfurt, and Croatia starts on the far side of the Atlantic.
